scope: Ten selected passages checked against current local POB source files and existing decision records. Not a whole-Bible estimate or live-site audit.

records.current_english: Then a champion came out from the camps of the Philistines; his name was Goliath, from Gath. His height was six cubits and a span.
records.draft_english: Then a champion came out from the camps of the Philistines; his name was Goliath, from Gath. His height was four cubits and a span.

records.current_english: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of man, he fixed the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the sons of Israel.
records.draft_english: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of man, he fixed the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the sons of God.

records.current_english: And being angry, he stretched out his hand, touched him, and said to him, “I am willing; be cleansed.”
records.draft_english: And moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, touched him, and said to him, “I am willing; be cleansed.”

records.current_english: Your kingdom is a kingdom for all ages, and your dominion is throughout every generation.
records.witness_line_example: God is faithful in his words and loyal in all his deeds.
records.not_final_wording_reason: The line-presence preference does not settle God versus Yahweh/Lord or every word. The example follows the Qumran witness.

records.current_english: No one has ever seen God; the one and only God, who is in the bosom of the Father, has made him known.
records.reason: God is already in POB; the alternative Son is already footnoted. The pinned SBLGNT apparatus also assigns the God reading to WH, Treg, and NA28. This is edition-level corroboration, not a completed manuscript adjudication.

records.current_english: I want to remind you, though you know all things once for all, that Jesus, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who did not believe.
records.reason: Jesus is already in POB and alternatives are footnoted. The pinned apparatus lists NA28 with this name; comparison does not create a new English change here.

records.current_english: Here is wisdom: let the one who has understanding calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man, and its number is six hundred sixty-six.
records.reason: 616 is already footnoted. Its existence alone does not establish that POB should replace 666.

records.current_english: From the anguish of his soul he will see and be satisfied; by his knowledge my righteous servant will justify many, and he will bear their iniquities.
records.reason: The existing note records the light variant; the expanded queue has not yet made an adopted source-choice decision for this verse.

records.current_english: Know that Yahweh is God. He made us, and we did not make ourselves; we are his people and the sheep of his pasture.
records.reason: We are his is already footnoted. This is a written/read tradition issue; the inventory is not yet a decision to switch readings.

records.current_english: Though he slay me, I will not wait; yet I will argue my ways before him.
records.reason: Hope in him is already footnoted. The consonantal written/read difference and the English rendering of the verb both require judgment.
